# WebContentKind

What a fetched URL turned out to be, which decides how it was turned into text.

**Kind:** a string enum, used in responses.

## Values

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `"Page"` | A web page, read as Markdown. |
| `"Document"` | A document (PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, CSV, JSON, XML), its text extracted. |
| `"Text"` | Plain text or Markdown, kept as it is. |
| `"Image"` | An image, described in words. |

New values can appear, so treat one you don't know as "something else", not as an error.

## Where it's used

- Inside [`IngestedFileWebSource`](ingested-file-web-source.md)
